# std.mem

Moving values between places. Core re-exports `swap`, so no module imports it.

Import: `use std.mem.{...}`.

## Functions

- `fn swap<T>(mut a: T, mut b: T)` — `swap(mut a, mut b)`: each place takes the other's value (R05.8.2).
